paths.case: job does not yet exist; gate/source/list/config refusal
steps: defaults or inherited execute raises before runner creates job/run
write_json calls Path.write_bytes without parent mkdir
FileNotFoundError becomes outer exception; original refusal remains chained
paths.impact: Expected STOP_NO_RETRY JSON is absent; refusal itself still prevents model/data work.

paths.case: job already exists and is writable
steps: existing file may be overwritten or a new failure file added
paths.impact: Rejected existing results directory may be modified; this is static reachability, not an observed overwrite.

cpu_wiring_scope: Calls execute directly and stops at config; never enters CLI main exception handler.
minimum_disposition: Only write failure records in a job legitimately created by this invocation; preserve original exception/nonzero exit and leave preexisting or uncreated job untouched on early refusal.
minimal_acceptance: Early refusal before job creation retains original error without second file-write exception.
Preexisting rejected job contents remain byte-identical.
out_of_scope: No full numerical rerun or full-history regression
